info.title: einvoice 0.1.0-preview.1.96+be1d6d7bb8c3074af62d9a46c1651bb2e3b0bec1 — electronic invoices, from the command line.
info.description:
Validate, inspect and convert electronic invoices from the command line. UBL 2.1, UN/CEFACT CII,
      Factur-X PDFs and lifecycle messages, checked against EN 16931 and the national rule sets you point it
      at. The reference validator in this space is a Java jar; this is the .NET one.

options.name: --rules
options.description: add Schematron, source or compiled, that we may not ship

options.name: --lenient
options.description: how hard reading should be on a document

options.name: --out
options.description:
write there instead of standard output (convert)
Exit codes: 0 conforming, 1 rejected or unchecked, 2 could not run.
UBL, CII, Factur-X PDFs and lifecycle messages. EN 16931, XRechnung, France,
Germany and Belgium are built in; artefacts that may not be redistributed are
fetched — see build/fetch-specs.sh — and pointed at with --rules.
